relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: It also enhances VEGF, MMPs, IL-8, and COX-2 expression, linking hypoxia to angiogenesis, invasion, prostaglandin production, and inflammation [47].

relationships.subject: COX-2
relationships.evidence_quote: Cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), consistently elevated in stromal cells, drives sustained PGE2 production.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: In EM, PGE2 reduces macrophage MMP-9 and CD36 expression, impairing phagocytosis and promoting lesion persistence [54].

relationships.subject: STAT3
relationships.evidence_quote: Regulators such as signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), B-cell lymphoma 6 (BCL6), and sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) suppress PGR targets

key_findings: Review frames endometriosis as a systemic inflammatory disease driven by HIF-1α/VEGF/COX-2/PGE2 loops and progesterone resistance.
Epigenetic regulators including HDAC inhibitors are proposed as therapeutic avenues.
